rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for company stock that people buy, sell, or hold.

example.english: I bought a share in that company.
example.traditional: 我買咗嗰間公司嘅股票。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gu2 piu3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing an ownership stake in a company rather than the tradable stock itself.

example.english: They have a thirty-percent share in the company.
example.traditional: 佢喺間公司有三成股份。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 saam1 sing4 gu2 fan6

rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when giving somebody else part of food, money, space, or another thing you have.

example.english: I share this cake with someone.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 daan6 gou1 ngo5 fan1 bei2 jan4 sik6

rows.note: Use this for a portion or allotted part of something, such as a share of loot or food.

example.english: I put your share of the roast meat in the fridge.
example.traditional: 你嗰份燒味我擺咗喺雪櫃。
example.jyutping: nei5 go2 fan6 siu1 mei6 ngo5 baai2 zo2 hai2 syut3 gwai6

rows.note: Use this for sharing a story, experience, opinion, or information with other people rather than simply reporting it.

example.english: I want to share some funny stories from my trip.
example.traditional: 我想分享吓我旅行嘅趣事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 fan1 hoeng2 haa5 ngo5 leoi5 hang4 ge3 ceoi3 si6

rows.note: Use this when A and another person use the same place, object, or facility together.

example.english: I share a computer with Ming.
example.traditional: 我同阿明一齊用部電腦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 jung6 bou6 din6 nou5

rows.note: Use this when people have a characteristic, interest, experience, or other thing in common.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 gung6 tung4 ge3 hing3 ceoi3
